notes.title: NanoApostle is OUT NOW
notes.notes:
[h2]The wait is over! [/h2]

Today marks PQube and 18Light Games' official release of NanoApostle, now available! This action-packed adventure blends intense combat, strategic depth, and a gripping storyline, delivering a gaming experience like no other.

Watch the Launch Trailer NOW.

[previewyoutube=UyzjQJH-otk;full][/previewyoutube]

Set deep within a sinister research facility, NanoApostle follows the journey of Anita, a girl created through experimental procedures and fused with a sentient nanomechanical entity known as ‘Apostle’. Together, they must navigate a nightmarish labyrinth filled with deadly bio-weapons and find a way to escape their dark prison.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779293/3b5b4b239b35433ba189fed46164296a57560772.gif[/img]

[b]Battle Against Merciless Adversaries:[/b] Take on a terrifying array of enemies, from axe-wielding mechs and fire-spewing behemoths to psychokinetic horrors, in brutal encounters that push your combat skills to the limit.

[b]Evolving Multi-Stage Battles:[/b] Face off against bioweapons that become more dangerous as they’re cornered, often altering the environment around you to intensify their attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779293/5bd5755bf8213d99a732e5449ae7e1c3295d942f.gif[/img]

[b]More Than a Weapon:[/b] Anita’s bond with Apostle grants her a range of abilities, including Dodge, Parry, Slashing Attacks, and a deadly Projectile, making her a formidable force against her enemies.

[b]Master the Destruction Point System:[/b] Use Apostle’s nanites to locate and exploit structural weaknesses in your opponents, allowing you to land devastating blows at just the right moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779293/32b766113a0fd6baf27cfb53cd179f8a3166d688.gif[/img]

[b]Experiment with Skills: [/b]Earn skill points through combat and challenge stages, and create unique skill combinations that suit your playstyle—whether tactical or all-out aggressive.

[b]Take on the Challenge System:[/b] Test your skills with various tasks, from battling hordes of enemies to demonstrating your dexterity in parkour challenges, and earn valuable skill points to power up Anita and Apostle.

Thank you from the teams at PQube & 18Light Games, we hope you enjoy!

notes.title: 🗓️🎉 NanoApostle release date revealed!
notes.notes:
[h3]🚨SECURITY BREACH 🚨[/h3]

Awaken Anita, step forth into the darkness, and confront the myriad biomechanical monstrosities that await in the depths of a top-secret weapons lab as [b]NanoApostle[/b] launches on [b]Steam[/b] and [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] [b]12 September 2024!
[/b]
If you haven’t tried [b]NanoApostle[/b] yet our [b]Steam demo[/b] is still available - Complete the tutorial to learn the fundamentals of the combat system before testing your skills against the ferocious [b]A-300 Humanoid Mech: Berserker[/b] and [b]Semi-Autonomous L-Cannon: Commander.[/b]

[h3]The story so far…[/h3]

During the 362nd year of the Kote Calendar, a mysterious institution known as [b]The Pioneers[/b] laid siege to the nation of [b]Palanlak[/b]. The Pioneers seek to capture individuals with a unique mindset that allows them to perceive any being’s weakness and transform them into lethal [b]Nanomachine hybrids.[/b]

What began as a military experiment, the NanoApostle Project aims to develop AI-driven nanomachines that can enhance a human host. Together, the host and machine would be the perfect soldier, adaptable to any situation. Anita, a young girl with no memories of her previous life, wakes up in one of The Pioneers’ Biochemical Weapons Labs implanted with the nanomachine entity called Apostle.

[h3]Vulnerability detected![/h3]

The [b]Destruction Point system[/b] is the key to defeating the many dangerous bosses you’ll be coming up against. Every enemy has a weakness and Anita can utilise her Nanites to exploit them. During combat, a boss will occasionally be [b]exposed to a counterattack[/b], represented by a depleting circle surrounding the boss. Attacking your foe during this brief window with either a melee or ranged attack will trigger the Destruction Point. If done correctly, Anita will stagger the enemy and a [b]second prompt to grapple[/b] towards them will appear. This move will significantly damage the boss briefly [b]staggered for follow-up strikes.[/b] 

Anita can also trigger the Destruction Point by successfully [b]parrying[/b] certain attacks or [b]deflecting blasts[/b] back at the boss.

A big thank you to everyone who has supported us on this project so far, and we can’t wait for you to dive into NanoApostle when it [u][b]releases in a few weeks time![/b][/u]

18Light Game Ltd & PQube

[h2]Welcome Everyone,[/h2]

We have a special announcement to make, the demo for [b][i]NanoApostle[/i][/b] is now live! We will also be showcasing the demo live at WASD in the UK between the 25th and 27th of April.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779293/acb9886c2263118588082451c538a254a5859f96.png[/img]
Complete the tutorial and tackle [b]two ferocious boss battles[/b] against the [b]Berserker[/b] and the [b]Commander[/b]. Wielding[b] two giant axes[/b], the Berserker overwhelms with a flurry of close range strikes before leaping into the air to unleash a [b]devastating ground pound[/b]. The Destruction Point system is the key to defeating these imposing boss battles. Every enemy has a weakness and Anita can utilise her [b]Nanites[/b] to exploit them. During combat, the boss will occasionally be exposed to a counterattack, this is represented by a [b]depleting circle[/b] surrounding the boss.
